title: Monotone compact exhaustion modulo a null set (σ-compact metric space)
statement: Let X be a σ-compact metric space with its Borel σ-algebra, μ any measure on X, and A ⊆ X μ-null-measurable with μ(A) < ∞. Then there are compact sets Q_0 ⊆ Q_1 ⊆ Q_2 ⊆ … contained in A with μ(A ∖ ⋃_j Q_j) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [SigmaCompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (A : Set X), NullMeasurableSet A μ → μ A < ⊤ → ∃ Q : ℕ → Set X, (∀ j, IsCompact (Q j)) ∧ (∀ j, Q j ⊆ A) ∧ Monotone Q ∧ μ (A \ ⋃ j, Q j) = 0
